answer: Deferred-credit issuance: each new identity must submit a signed work artifact at enrollment, but its reward is withheld and released only after a randomly chosen verifier reviews it at the next dawn. A clone farm pays full compute and labor cost upfront for every fake identity while recovery stays gated on independent review. Duplicate submissions share one quill signature and forfeit all held rewards; a missed pulse check voids the queue, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV at roughly the cost of one full artifact plus foregone payout.
